# Trailblaze

> Senior, hands-on AI-adoption consultancy for engineering teams. France-first. A small team of veteran operators (CTOs, CPOs, senior ICs) who have run AI-first development since early 2025.

## What we do

- Workshops and 1:1 coaching to get engineers genuinely productive with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot).
- Custom tooling: adoption and velocity dashboards, prompt logging and reporting, and bespoke internal tools.
- Engineering at the core, with design, product, and sales experts brought in when needed.

## How we work

1. A free first conversation.
2. We work alongside your team: workshops, materials, and time in your meetings.
3. Ongoing support after handover.

## Pricing

- A flat daily fee per expert (the figure is shared in the first conversation).
- First conversation is free.
- You pay only for days worked.
- No lock-in.

## Who it's for

Teams that already have AI tools but little internal guidance, based in France and Europe.

## Clients

Backupta, Lyvoc, Alma.

## Why us

- We use what we teach: AI-first daily since early 2025.
- Senior-only, no juniors.
- We focus on skill transfer, unlike integrators, ESNs, Big-4 firms, or hiring.
